title: IEA EBC Annex 71 Twin Houses: Main Experiment Data and Supplementary Documents
version: Fordatis dataset 76.2, main-experiment and supplementary-document archives
publisher: Fraunhofer Institute for Building Physics IBP

units.timestamp: source Excel serial interpreted as fixed Central European Time (UTC+1); the Extended archive contains the complete 02:00 hour at the spring DST transition

measurement_uncertainty.description: The official supplementary measurement-channel registry reports sensor and acquisition-system specifications. These values are retained as source metadata and are not yet propagated into weighted acceptance scores.

by_variable.room_air_temperature: PT100 sensor specified as +/-0.015 K, with +/-1.5 K possible under full solar irradiation; acquisition-system accuracy 0.1 K
by_variable.relative_humidity: outdoor sensor specified accuracy +/-2 percentage points; room acquisition-system accuracy 3 percentage points
by_variable.solar_radiation: CMP11 channels specified as less than 2%
by_variable.mechanical_ventilation_volume_flow: specified as 3.5 cubic metres per hour; acquisition-system accuracy 0.03 cubic metres per hour

known_gaps: This is the IEA EBC Annex 71 main experiment, not the originally proposed Annex 58 Experiment 1 calibration and Experiment 2 blind-validation pair.
The historical one-room 60/40 helper diagnostic is retained for provenance and remains rejected.
The replacement maps four official N2 air bodies through the object production adapter, but the later target period was inspected during mapper repair and is not unseen validation.

The selected alignment maps each source row to the preceding hour before conversion to canonical interval-start timestamps. This is supported by a lag audit and the published experiment start, but the workbook label convention is not independently proven.
The production path now represents the measured heater convective/radiative split and mechanical supply-air temperature explicitly.
The official supplementary archive is checksum-registered and supplies plans, construction properties, a measurement-channel list, shading geometry, and supporting material.
A source audit found that the Extended Experiment retains 02:00 through 02:50 on 31 March 2019; fixed CET is required to avoid duplicate UTC instants.
The source-determined 30-degree attic roof-window tilt is now mapped explicitly.

Canonical v1 still lacks per-opening blind state, component-resolved construction topology, and a time-varying cellar boundary contract; reported channel uncertainty is not yet propagated into weighted scoring.
Both registered empirical thermal results remain rejected; the registered energy-path audit is diagnostic and none may be used as evidence for a passing blind-validation claim.

preprocessing.description: Verify the archive checksum, join N2 living-room, opening-state, solar, and weather channels by Excel timestamp, retain the historical 60/40 transfer for forensic reproduction, and emit a protocol audit that prevents it from being treated as production-engine or official blind/open validation.

Join official N2 and weather workbooks by timestamp, apply the documented lag-audited hourly alignment, allocate the published whole-house HTC with stable coheat observations, compile the four-air-body canonical graph, run the object production adapter, and preserve the failed numerical and sealed-target decisions.

Constrain each interval with measured air temperature, evolve the unmeasured mass node conditionally, and decompose storage, envelope, supply-air ventilation, interzone, air-mass, and source paths without fitting a correction.

Inspect checksum-registered plans, construction properties, and channel metadata; apply the source-determined 30-degree roof tilt; then test source timing, heater split, initial mass state, and capacity allocation under a frozen cross-period decision rule without fitting.

permitted_use.purpose: Forensic reduced-order thermal mapping and validation-protocol audit
permitted_use.notes: Preserve attribution and ShareAlike terms for redistributed derivatives. Do not describe the same-experiment holdout as Annex 58 Experiment 2 or as a successful validation.
